overview_description.description: Swipemint is a Dubai-based financial lifestyle company that specializes in converting standard plastic credit and debit cards into customized metal cards. The company offers personalized card designs using materials such as stainless steel, gold, and matte finishes, targeting customers interested in luxury branding and premium payment accessories. Swipemint operates primarily through online orders and provides services including custom engraving, logo integration, and secure transfer of EMV chip data from existing bank cards to newly manufactured metal cards.
